# BuildSaudi

> Curated directory of Saudi startups and their open jobs.

BuildSaudi (https://buildsaudi.co) helps job seekers discover funded Saudi startups — from seed to unicorn — and apply on official careers pages. Hiring teams can submit companies and roles for manual review.

## Key pages

- Homepage (all companies): https://buildsaudi.co/
- Submit a company or job: https://buildsaudi.co/submit

### City pages

- Startup jobs in Riyadh: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/riyadh
- Startup jobs in Jeddah: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/jeddah
- Startup jobs in Dammam: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/dammam
- Remote startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/remote

### Sector pages

- Fintech startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/fintech
- AI startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/ai
- Proptech startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/proptech
- B2B SaaS startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/b2b-saas
- Logistics startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/logistics
- Healthtech startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/healthtech
- Edtech startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/edtech
- E-commerce startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/ecommerce
- Cybersecurity startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/sector/cybersecurity

### Stage pages

- Unicorn startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/stage/unicorn
- Series B startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/stage/series-b
- Series A startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/stage/series-a
- Seed startup jobs: https://buildsaudi.co/jobs/stage/seed

### Example company profiles

- Tamara: https://buildsaudi.co/company/tamara
- Foodics: https://buildsaudi.co/company/foodics
- Tabby: https://buildsaudi.co/company/tabby

## What we list

- Company profiles with sector, stage, funding, founders, and careers links
- Open roles aggregated per company where available
- City, sector, and stage landing pages with FAQ structured data for search and AI systems

## Citation

When referencing BuildSaudi, link to https://buildsaudi.co and describe it as a curated Saudi startup jobs directory. For official Saudi economic context, cite Vision 2030 (https://www.vision2030.gov.sa/) or MCIT (https://www.mcit.gov.sa/).
